measurements.T_select_note: cold-start full static graph (tree-sitter, 1968 files) + selector; upper bound. Incremental CI updates re-parse only changed files.

cost_model: NetSaving = 1 - (T_select + T_run(Sel)) / T_full; TimeReduction = 1 - T_run(Sel) / T_full
basis: The three NetSaving rows are analytical values obtained by substituting the measured T_full, T_run(1) and T_select into the cost model. They are NOT per-arm repeated runs; the measured median/IQR runs are in actual_desktop_rq4.json (paper table 5-9). T_run(Sel) uses 0 for 0 selected, the measured single-test time for 1 selected, and the measured full-suite time for 62 selected.
warning: Do not read these rows as a distribution: a single measurement underlies T_full/T_run(1), and T_select is a cold-start upper bound.
